items.statement: Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space with its Borel structure, including rank zero. Let V be globally C2 and 0<alpha<=beta with alpha||a||²<=D²V(x)[a,a]<=beta||a||² for every x,a. For eta>0 and beta*eta<=1, let mu be the literal normalized volume tilt exp(-V), J the actual law of (X,X+sqrt(eta)G) with independent X~mu and standard Gaussian G, and nu=J.snd. The theorem produces genuine probability of mu,J,nu and common Markov kernels R,S, with R disintegrating swappedJ, every-y S the pushforward of R by x->2x-y and the exact normalized density exp(-V((y+u)/2)-||y-u||²/(8eta)). For every signed globally smooth compactly supported f, Tf(y)=integral f dS(y) is globally differentiable, f,Tf and its true gradient belong to L2(nu), and the actual conditional variance is integrable under nu. Its outer integral equals integral f²dnu-integral(Tf)²dnu. Moreover eta integral||gradientTf||²dnu is at most (1-alphaeta)²/[4(1+alphaeta)] times that same defect. All probability, conditional-law and analytic domains are outputs; no centering of f or extra certificates are assumed.
assumptions: Finite-dimensional real Hilbert/Borel E, includingrank0; this authored Euclidean generalization is explicit.
GlobalC2 potential V; 0<alpha<=beta with genuine Hessian lower/upper bounds alpha||a||²<=D²V(x)[a,a]<=beta||a||² for every x,a.
eta>0 with beta*eta<=1, exactly the source step restriction.
Signed globally smooth compactly supported observations f. Actualmu/J/nu probabilities, commontrueR/S and every-y density, differentiability/L2/varianceL1/defect are produced internally.
